reason: A notification and monitoring plugin that checks installed dsh plugins for newer npm versions and presents user-approved upgrade options.

summaries.zh: 定期检查已安装的 dsh 插件是否有新的 npm 版本，并通过审批提示提供升级选项。
summaries.en: Checks installed dsh plugins for newer npm versions and presents user approval options for upgrading them.

capabilities: Queries an npm-compatible registry for installed plugin versions
Monitors installed plugins on a schedule or via /check-updates
Displays approval questions for available updates
Sends approved upgrade instructions to the agent
Stores declined version decisions in the profile directory
